stories.title: Bank of Canada raises benchmark rate to 2.5% to address inflation risk from energy prices
stories.summary: On Oct 28, the Bank of Canada increased its policy rate by a quarter‑point to 2.5 percent, its first change after seven consecutive meetings and the first hike since July 2023. Governor Tiff Macklem said the move was needed to lower the risk that elevated energy prices, which pushed September inflation to 3.1 percent, would spread to broader inflation, while noting the rate remains low enough not to restrain growth.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.

stories.title: Renfe high‑speed train collides with Iryo train between Mora and Orgaz after signalling error
stories.summary: At about 08:30 local time on a Wednesday, a Renfe high‑speed train carrying 397 passengers was ordered to proceed despite a computer failure that had halted all services on the Madrid‑Seville line. It struck the rear of an Iryo train with 147 passengers between the municipalities of Mora and Orgaz, roughly 140 km south of Madrid. Several passengers suffered injuries, including broken arms, broken noses and a rail that penetrated a carriage roof.
stories.why: The incident highlights the need for fail‑safe signalling and clear procedural controls to avoid train collisions.

stories.previousSummary: Two high‑speed trains traveling south from Madrid to Seville were stopped after a computer failure in the automatic signalling system. The Renfe train, carrying 397 passengers, was mistakenly ordered to proceed and collided with the preceding Iryo train, which had 147 passengers, between Mora and Orgaz about 140 km south of Madrid. The crash caused broken arms, broken noses and a rail to pierce a passenger’s roof.

stories.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at Johannismühle wildlife park
stories.summary: An eight‑year‑old girl was seriously injured when a wolf attacked her inside an enclosure at the Johannismühle wildlife park in Brandenburg, south of Berlin. She was with a staff member and two other children at the time. The girl was air‑lifted to hospital by helicopter on Wednesday; no one else was injured and police are investigating the precise circumstances.
stories.why: The incident highlights safety and visitor‑protection concerns in wildlife parks.

stories.title: RBI raises treasury bill auction cutoff yields by 20 basis points
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced that the cutoff yield for its most recent treasury bill auction was set 20 basis points higher than the yield used in the preceding auction. This change was disclosed in the RBI’s official auction results release. The higher cutoff establishes a new benchmark rate for short‑term government securities in the market.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Microsoft discloses Azure Q3 revenue of $33.2 billion
stories.summary: Microsoft reported Azure generated $33.2 billion in the July‑September quarter, a 48% increase year‑over‑year and about $850 million above analysts’ $32.3 billion estimate. The revenue represented roughly 36% of Microsoft’s total quarterly revenue of $92.3 billion, putting Azure slightly ahead of Google Cloud’s $30.7 billion for the same period. The growth also exceeded the 44‑45% range forecast by CFO Amy Hood.
stories.why: Investors can now benchmark Azure directly against rival cloud providers that already disclose dollar revenue.

stories.title: RBI Deputy Governor says India to cut debt‑to‑GDP ratio by 2031
stories.summary: The RBI Deputy Governor told the Economic Times that, based on current projections, India is the only major emerging economy expected to see its debt‑to‑GDP ratio decline by the year 2031, while other peers are projected to hold steady or rise. The statement was reported without additional quantitative details.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.previousSummary: RBI Deputy Governor said India is the only major emerging economy expected to lower its overall debt‑to‑GDP ratio by 2031. The statement was reported by The Economic Times. No further details on the projected ratio or the assumptions behind it were provided, but the comment highlights a contrast with other emerging markets that are expected to see stable or rising debt ratios over the same period.

stories.title: Microsoft reports $10 billion in OpenAI revenue for Q3
stories.summary: Microsoft generated $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI in the quarter ended September 30, 2026, representing nearly 11% of its $92.3 billion quarterly total. Full-year 2026 OpenAI revenue was $24.1 billion, with annualized projections reaching $40 billion at the current pace. The company also reported $7.2 billion in outstanding receivables from OpenAI, up from $6 billion at end of June.
stories.why: It shows the scale of Microsoft's financial dependence on OpenAI despite growing competition.

stories.title: Nvidia releases free open‑weight transcription model Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
stories.summary: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a free open‑weight speech model that can transcribe audio in up to 40 languages, translate 31 languages to and from English, handle recordings up to an hour long, and distinguish up to eight speakers. The 30‑billion‑parameter model, which Nvidia says outperforms rivals on benchmarks such as Hugging Face’s Open ASR Leaderboard, can run on a single Nvidia chip and is aimed at developers building business‑meeting and medical‑transcription applications.
stories.why: It reduces technical and cost barriers for developers creating multilingual, speaker‑aware transcription tools for enterprise and healthcare use.
